name: Cash-Backed Maturity Extension
expression: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(oancf, ib), at)), MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(dlc, at), 1))), IND_RANK(DELTA(RATIO(dltt, at), 1))))

name: Financed Phantom-Earnings Absorption
expression: MUL(MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(ib, at)), IND_RANK(RATIO(NEG(oancf), at))), IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(ADD(SUB(sstk, prstkc), SUB(dltis, dltr)), DELTA(che, 1)), LAG(at, 1))))

name: Noncash-Equity Recapitalization Failure
expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(DELTA(ceq, 1), ADD(SUB(sstk, prstkc), SUB(ib, dvc))), at), 1)), MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(sstk, prstkc), LAG(at, 1))), IND_RANK(RATIO(ADD(NEG(DELTA(che, 1)), DELTA(dlc, 1)), LAG(at, 1)))))

name: Cash-Efficient Depreciation Congruence
expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(MIN(RANK(NEG(WINSOR(MA(ABS(SUB(GROWTH(dpc, 1), GROWTH(sale, 1))), 3), 1))), RANK(NEG(ABS(RATIO(SUB(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1)), SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1))), at)))))), INDICATOR(TREND(RATIO(sale, at), 3), 0))

name: Growth-Confirmed Asset-Release Funding
expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(NEG(SUB(DELTA(act, 1), DELTA(che, 1))), SUB(DELTA(lct, 1), DELTA(dlc, 1))), sale)), MUL(INDICATOR(DELTA(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), sale), 1), 0), INDICATOR(GROWTH(sale, 1), 0)))

name: Cash-Conversion Equity Dependence
expression: MIN(RANK(RATIO(SUB(sstk, prstkc), at)), RANK(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), at)))

name: Cash-Backed Distress Deleveraging
expression: MIN(RANK(RATIO(SUB(dltr, dltis), at)), MIN(RANK(RATIO(oancf, at)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(re, at)))))

name: Unabsorbed External Financing
expression: WINSOR(SUB(RATIO(ADD(SUB(sstk, prstkc), SUB(dltis, dltr)), at), RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(xrd, 0), COALESCE(xad, 0)), at)), 1)

name: Commercialization-Confirmed Persistent Knowledge Loss
expression: MIN(IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), sale), 3)), MIN(RANK(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(ADD(ib, COALESCE(xrd, 0)), lt)), 1)), RANK(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(revt, ADD(lt, TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 3)))), 1))))

name: Internal Funding Coverage
expression: RATIO(SUB(oancf, ADD(capx, aqc)), ADD(ABS(oancf), ADD(ABS(capx), ABS(aqc))))

name: High-Leverage Equity Repair
expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(sstk, LAG(at, 1)), 1)), MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(NEG(DELTA(lt, 1)), LAG(at, 1)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(LAG(RATIO(lt, at), 1), 1))))

name: Deployed External Capital Bottleneck
expression: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(ADD(DELTA(ppent, 1), DELTA(invt, 1)), LAG(at, 1))), MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(ADD(SUB(sstk, prstkc), SUB(dltis, dltr)), LAG(at, 1))), IND_RANK(SUB(RATIO(ADD(SUB(sstk, prstkc), SUB(dltis, dltr)), LAG(at, 1)), RATIO(DELTA(che, 1), LAG(at, 1))))))

name: Asset-Liability Duration Alignment
expression: MUL(SUB(IND_RANK(RATIO(DELTA(ppegt, 1), LAG(at, 1))), IND_RANK(RATIO(DELTA(invt, 1), LAG(at, 1)))), SUB(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(dltis, dltr), LAG(at, 1))), IND_RANK(RATIO(DELTA(dlc, 1), LAG(at, 1)))))

name: Working-Capital-Released Self-Funded Capex
expression: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(capx, LAG(at, 1))), MIN(IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(invt, 1), LAG(at, 1)))), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(lt, 1), LAG(at, 1))))))

name: Goodwill Sell-Through Spread
expression: IND_RANK(WINSOR(MUL(RATIO(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), at), SUB(RATIO(DELTA(sale, 1), LAG(at, 1)), RATIO(DELTA(invt, 1), LAG(at, 1)))), 1))

name: Dual-Capital Earnings Instability
expression: IND_RANK(RATIO(VOL(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), at), 5), ADD(VOL(RATIO(SUB(sale, cogs), at), 5), MA(RATIO(ADD(capx, COALESCE(xrd, 0)), at), 3))))

name: Low Positive Operating-Funding Burden
expression: MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(SUB(revt, ADD(cogs, xsga)), revt), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(TS_MAX(RATIO(SUB(SUB(act, che), SUB(lct, dlc)), revt), 3))))

name: Accrual-to-Cash Realization Profit
expression: MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oibdp, at), 3)), IND_RANK(SUB(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(DELTA(RATIO(oancf, at), 1), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(LAG(WINSOR(RATIO(ADD(SUB(ib, oancf), dpc), at), 1), 1)))))

name: Self-Funded Innovation Capacity
expression: MUL(IND_RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(COALESCE(xrd, 0), at), 1)), IND_ADJ(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(oancf, ADD(sstk, dltis)), at), 1)))

name: Dual-Validated Organic Return
expression: IND_ADJ(WINSOR(RATIO(MIN(ADD(oiadp, COALESCE(xrd, 0)), ADD(oancf, COALESCE(xrd, 0))), ADD(at, COALESCE(gdwl, 0))), 1))

name: Profit-Eroding Expansion Breadth
expression: MUL(INDICATOR(IND_ADJ(MA(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at), 3)), 0), MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(invt, 1), LAG(at, 1)), 1)), MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(DELTA(ppegt, 1), LAG(at, 1)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(SUB(revt, cogs), 1), LAG(at, 1))), 1)))))

name: Dual Capital Starvation
expression: MUL(INDICATOR(IND_ADJ(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), 0), MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(SUB(capx, dp), ppent)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(NEG(RATIO(DELTA(COALESCE(xrd, SUB(revt, revt)), 1), LAG(at, 1))), 1))))

name: Asymmetric Revenue Resilience
expression: MUL(SUB(IND_RANK(TREND(RATIO(revt, at), 3)), IND_RANK(WINSOR(NEG(TS_SUM(MUL(DELTA(RATIO(revt, at), 1), INDICATOR(NEG(DELTA(RATIO(revt, at), 1)), 0)), 5)), 1))), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(che, MA(cogs, 3)))))

name: Stable-Cash Dividend Commitment
expression: MIN(MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(VOL(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)))), MIN(IND_RANK(MA(RATIO(dvc, at), 3)), IND_RANK(NEG(VOL(RATIO(dvc, at), 3)))))

name: Liquidity-Constrained Equity Preference
expression: MUL(IND_RANK(NEG(MA(RATIO(SUB(act, lct), at), 3))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(sstk, dltis), at)))

name: Equity-Funded Dividend Strain
expression: MUL(MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(sstk, at)), IND_RANK(RATIO(dvc, at))), NEG(IND_ZSCORE(MA(RATIO(SUB(oancf, dvc), at), 3))))

name: Organic Intangible Mix Cash Floor
expression: MIN(RANK(WINSOR(RATIO(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), ADD(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), gdwl)), 1)), RANK(WINSOR(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(oancf, xrd), sale), 3), 1)))

name: Conditional Knowledge Capital Overhang
expression: WINSOR(MUL(RATIO(SUB(LAG(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), 1), TS_SUM(ADD(oancf, xrd), 3)), ADD(LAG(at, 1), ADD(LAG(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), 1), ABS(TS_SUM(ADD(oancf, xrd), 3))))), INDICATOR(SUB(LAG(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), 1), TS_SUM(ADD(oancf, xrd), 3)), 0)), 1)

name: Liquid Sales Bargain
expression: MUL(RANK(RATIO(sale, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), RANK(RATIO(SUB(act, lct), at)))

name: Cash-Realized After-Tax Operating Value
expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(SUB(ebitda, MAX(txt, SUB(at, at))), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), 1)), IND_ZSCORE(WINSOR(RATIO(oancf, lct), 1)))

name: Balance-Sheet-Safe Retirement
expression: MIN(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, SUB(ADD(MUL(prcc_f, csho), ADD(dltt, dlc)), che))), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(SUB(prstkc, sstk), DELTA(ADD(dltt, dlc), 1)), at)))

name: Solvency-Weighted Liquidity Repurchase
expression: ADD(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(ebitda, MUL(prcc_f, csho))), MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(SUB(MIN(prstkc, MAX(SUB(che, dlc), SUB(ABS(SUB(che, dlc)), ABS(SUB(che, dlc))))), sstk), at)), IND_RANK(NEG(RATIO(lt, at)))))

name: Knowledge Productivity Floor Value
expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(oancf, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), at)), IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(revt, at), 5))))

name: Organic Recognition Shift Value
expression: MUL(IND_RANK(RATIO(ebitda, ADD(MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho), SUB(ADD(dltt, dlc), che)))), IND_RANK(TREND(SUB(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), at)), IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(COALESCE(intan, 0), at))), 3)))

name: Funded Active-Investment Value
expression: MUL(IND_ZSCORE(RATIO(oancf, MUL(ABS(prcc_f), csho))), MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(che, ADD(che, capx))), IND_RANK(RATIO(capx, at))))
